journal_lines: §aGreen in the old shaft wall. §oNot iron, not copper — something the original miners walked past. Took it.
§aDeep in the old workings, where the cart tracks ended: §l§aemeralds§a. Someone stopped digging too soon.
§aHalf-exposed at the chamber edge. §oThe wall had been protecting it. The wall is no longer an obstacle.
§aGreen so deep it caught the light from across the tunnel. §oCame free without forcing. Good sign.
§aChalk circle on the wall — someone had marked this spot and never come back. Dug where they had marked.
§aFound a name scratched into the timber above the seam. §oThey never reached it. I did. They would understand.
§aThe emerald came out clean. §oWrapped it before the walk back. Did not want to scratch it.
§aOld shaft, good stone. §oThe miners quit one wall too early. Their loss.
